text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. This session has no command-execution tool, so I checked each fix by reading it against its test. Please run the suite to confirm.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** the borrow limit `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the days late. It now multiplies them.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` had no "Emma", so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. I made up the author, year and copy count, since the tests only check the titles.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns the last `n`, or an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int, which also fixes `age`.
